name: Coconino County, AZ
findings: Coconino County has 385 nonprofit organizations. 170 of them (44%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 145 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (15% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Coconino County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Few religious organizations list public events
observations.text: 12 religious organizations here list public events. In similar places of this size, about 26 would.

confidence.text: Based on 26 organizations here; 41% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Do people here look for public events through religious groups? Where else does that happen?

observations.title: Hobby and sports organizations stand out for public events
observations.text: 14 hobby and sports organizations here list public events, compared with about 6 in similar places of this size.

confidence.text: Based on 14 organizations here; 41% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What role do hobby and sports organizations play in community life here? Who do they reach, and who might they miss?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 20 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 20 organizations here; 41% of all organizations here have no identified type.
